dominant_strengths: Confident oversized headline typography with strong hierarchy and a clean Figma-native sans treatment
Recognizable client logo strip provides immediate credibility and rhythmic horizontal pacing
dominant_weaknesses: Mid-scroll capture leaves awkward vertical whitespace between centered tagline and the next H1, breaking flow
Carousel controls float disconnected in the upper-right with no clear anchor to the logo strip they likely control
Composition feels like two stitched sections rather than a continuous narrative, hurting spatial cohesion
fix_priorities: Tighten vertical spacing between tagline, logo marquee, and the H1 so the scroll reads as one composed frame
Re-anchor carousel arrows/pause control directly adjacent to the logo strip with a clearer affordance
Introduce a subtle accent color or visual element to relieve the stark monochrome and elevate emotional pull
Add supporting subcopy or visual under the H1 to balance the heavy left-aligned headline mass
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity is decent thanks to legible nav and headlines, but visceral charm and reflective resonance are muted by sterile monochrome and disjointed sectioning.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a plausible Figma marketing scroll state, but the mid-transition framing makes it feel like an in-between moment rather than a resolved composition.
